payload.text: File a small issue, with hv as reporter, inside a chain. Between an intentd restart and its first endpoint read, the estate page prints `usage::NO_ENDPOINT` ("the account's usage endpoint is read by intentd's census tick, and this reading was not taken through it") under "usage endpoint failed". That names a reading not yet taken as a failure. It was seen on hv's live page at 11:53Z on 2026-10-27, and a few seconds later the estate op held a good reading (read_at 11:53:00.564Z). The text predates 0658: usage.rs has it at ddb749ca7. ic proposed it to vc at 11:54Z by ic's clock. No push, no release.
